title: Give the macOS release candidate qualification 75 minutes after v6.2.0-rc.1 timed out
description: Give the macOS release candidate qualification 75 minutes after v6.2.0-rc.1 timed out
no_spec_change_rationale: Release workflow job timeout and release notes only; no runtime, canonical API, Action default, risk or provenance policy changes.
acceptance_criteria: The release.yml qualify job allows 75 minutes, so a v6.2.0 candidate that passes every test on macos-15 is not cancelled during the release build; the 6.2.0 notes record rc.1's timeout.
